en: The postcard features a blue-tinted photograph of a public square with a prominent statue of a man in colonial attire on a pedestal, encircled by a fence. To the right, there is a large church or cathedral with a clock tower and cross, alongside some benches, street lamps, and surrounding trees. The bottom of the postcard has printed and handwritten text in French, with the printed part reading: 'ANGOLA – LOANDA – Estatua de Salvador Correia'. The handwritten message is in French, and the card is dated Lisboa, 2 January 1902.
